Effective November 5, 2026. By using Manglo.shop, you agree to these terms.

Using the toolkit

The tools are provided free of charge for lawful use. You are responsible for having the rights to any image you process and for checking that the resulting files meet your destination’s requirements.

Check your results

Image processing may change quality, metadata, dimensions, color or transparency. Keep original copies and inspect exports. Calculators provide estimates from the values you enter. They do not automatically account for every fee, tax, refund or business expense and are not financial or tax advice.

Availability and limitations

We aim to keep the tools useful, but provide them as available without a guarantee of uninterrupted operation or fitness for a specific purpose. Browser and device limitations may affect results. To the extent permitted by applicable law, Manglo is not responsible for losses resulting from reliance on tool output. Nothing here excludes rights that cannot legally be excluded.

Changes and feedback

Tools and these terms may change. The current effective date appears above. You can report problems through the support contact.
